review_evidence: Plausible/Gen.lean defines GenError, the Gen monad, choose/chooseNatLt, backtracking, list/array generators, frequency, permutationOf, and execution support.
Plausible/Arbitrary.lean defines the Arbitrary class and instances, while DeriveArbitrary.lean and DeriveShrinkable.lean implement reusable deriving machinery.
The PlausibleTest sources exercise these formal interfaces with actual inductive types and generated instances, so test naming alone is not a lossless exclusion criterion.
summary: Retain plausible because it formalizes a property-testing framework with reusable generators, shrinking, arbitrary/testable interfaces, and deriving machinery.
